svg.text: Compensation: if stock is short or the charge is declined, the saga calls inventory /release (when stock was reserved) and marks the order FAILED.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Business failures (out of stock, declined) are handled outcomes: the order ends FAILED and the execution SUCCEEDS.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only an unexpected crash makes an execution FAILED, and that pages someone.

svg.text: Every service has its own identity; nothing is public (no allUsers). Only the gateway may call orders-api; only the saga may call inventory and payments.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Internal routes (/internal/*) are not in the OpenAPI spec, so the gateway cannot reach them · No service-account keys · Dedicated Cloud Build SA, digest-pinned image

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Idempotency-Key → deterministic order id (retries can't double-order) · Firestore transactions prevent overselling · state in a versioned private bucket

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The client mints a Google-signed JWT for the dedicated client service account (audience sop-orders-api) and calls the gateway

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: API Gateway verifies signature and audience, rejects everything else (401), and calls orders-api with its own service-account identity

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: orders-api validates the body and creates the order as PENDING; the order id derives from the Idempotency-Key, so a retry returns the same order

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It publishes OrderCreated to Pub/Sub and answers 202 immediately; the client polls GET /orders/{id}

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eventarc delivers the event to Cloud Workflows, starting one saga execution

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The saga reserves stock (inventory, Firestore transaction) then charges (payments); a 503 from payments is retried with exponential backoff

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If stock is short or the charge is declined, the saga compensates: releases the reservation and marks the order FAILED with a reason

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On success (or after compensation) the saga PATCHes the final status through the internal API: orders-api stays the single writer of order state
